label: Signer list removal and verification
initiation: The signer proposes his own removal from the verification trust list.
outcome: Reviewers discuss technical consequences; the merged list omits the key. The controlled wrapper test confirms a membership gate.
alternative_explanation: A verification membership change does not describe every institutional privilege or establish involuntary removal.
level_rationale: Routine role transition and verification maintenance; a constitutional interpretation needs evidence of changed collective-choice powers.
